The token is -97.47% from its all-time high of $2.64, recorded on March 1, 2024. Its all-time low is $0.0427, recorded on April 5, 2026, while the 30-day move is +44.22%. Circulating supply is 1,168,553,195.47, total supply is 1,240,561,049.45, and max supply is not available. Market cap and FDV can diverge when a large portion of supply is not circulating, so investors should compare circulating supply, total supply, and unlock or emission information before relying on valuation multiples.

## What Could Change the Setup

Weak follow-through, falling volume, large unlocks, contract migrations, or negative security events would weaken the research case even if the spot price rises for a short period.
